# DualDrivenHybridNetwork

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A network architecture that fuses two distinct data streams—frame-based and event-based—through complementary processing pathways to jointly estimate and remove motion blur. Demonstrates a scalable integration strategy for heterogeneous sensory inputs, relevant to TCC designs where diverse data modalities must be processed in-network.
